title: Azad Canteen
text: Azad Canteen, also known as Ravi Da's Canteen or simply Ravi Da, is the main canteen of Azad Hall of Residence. It usually opens in the evening around 9 pm and remains open till 2-3 am. Major employees of the canteen are Manoj, Praveen and Ajay, apart from the owner Mr. Ravi.

Azad Canteen

Azad Canteen, also known as Ravi Da's Canteen or simply Ravi Da, is the main canteen of Azad Hall of Residence. It usually opens in the evening around 9 pm and remains open till 2-3 am. Major employees of the canteen are Manoj, Praveen and Ajay, apart from the owner Mr. Ravi.
